pages.text: Place the controller on the ground, 8 to 24 $(item)tower sections$() on it a $(item)power plant casing$() (the nacelle) on top and a $(item)rotor hub$() on the front of the nacelle. Hang 3 $(item)blades$() on the hub (right-click with a blade; sneak with an empty hand takes one off), then $(thing)right-click the hub$() or the controller to assemble the plant; missing blocks are marked.

The blades need a free disc of radius 4 around the hub; every block in it takes 5% off.$(br2)Up to $(thing)1000 FE/t$(), growing with the height of the nacelle: full at Y 150 and above, weak below Y 105. Rain adds 25%, thunder 50%.
